scope: GTK3 native parent and terminal teardown replacement, with synchronous callback reentry and focus preservation

obligations.replacement: Native GTK3 vertical GtkBox/scrolled parent under the display-shell controller replaces the legacy GtkBox subclass. Existing BindingStore/Connection/Source ownership handles callbacks and terminal teardown; synchronous reentry preserves newer selection and normal same-target canvas focus. No legacy Interface::cast or duplicate GType is introduced.
